clue.text: Sweepstake on which witches rode high

definitions.text: Sweepstake on which witches rode high

parts.words: Sweepstake on which witches rode high
parts.note: the lottery word sweepstake is split into a sweeping tool and a pole, the stick a witch flies on

explanation.surface: A betting pool that witches placed their money on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sweepstake' looks like a lottery, but read it as a sweeper's brush on a stake: the flying stick of folklore witches.
explanation.definitionFit: Folklore witches fly on a besom, a brush made of twigs bound to a long handle.

clue.text: Very low perch

definitions.meaning: deepest in pitch, as the lowest singing voice
a freshwater fish, standing for a related sea fish of the same family

explanation.definitionFit: A deep voice is the lowest register in music; the sea fish named this way belongs to the perch-like order of fish.

clue.text: Bow decoration is on woven cane

parts.note: the OBE (Order of the British Empire) is an honour awarded in Britain

indicators.note: something woven has its strands interlaced, so the letters of cane are rearranged

explanation.surface: A bow-shaped ornament sits on a piece of woven cane basketwork.
explanation.walkthrough: 'woven' turns CANE into ANCE, placed after OBE and IS. 'Bow' is the noun for a respectful bending of the body, not a ribbon.
explanation.definitionFit: A deferential bend of the body is a gesture of homage or respect.

clue.text: What the sulky did to make cycling easier

definitions.meaning: a sulky person behaved gloomily and listlessly, past tense
a motorised bicycle, which lightens the pedalling

explanation.definitionFit: A sulker brooded listlessly; a small motorbike with pedals takes the effort out of riding.

clue.text: Land has to soak up heavy shower

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word for soak is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to ret flax is to soak it to soften the fibres
rain is a shower of water from the sky, here a heavy one

explanation.surface: The ground must absorb a downpour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns RET into TER, followed by RAIN. RET is a textile term for soaking flax or hemp.
explanation.definitionFit: Ground considered for its physical features, a stretch of country.

clue.text: Defied-the red traffic light?

definitions.meaning: went against, thwarted someone's wishes
what a driver who ignores the stop signal did, ran past it

explanation.definitionFit: To thwart someone is to oppose them; a reckless driver drove across the junction against the signal.

clue.text: Support couple with little work

parts.note: PR is the abbreviation for pair
OP, short for opus, a musical work

explanation.surface: Backing a couple who do only a little work.
explanation.definitionFit: A prop is a beam or post holding something up.

clue.text: Wake up or turn up to employment

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up means the word or is read from bottom to top

parts.note: use means employment, putting something to work

explanation.surface: Get out of bed, or show up for your job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn up' reverses OR into RO, then USE follows; 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To stir from sleep, to awaken someone.

clue.text: Not hesitating to use the start button?

definitions.meaning: continuing resolutely, carrying on
literally pushing the switch that turns a machine on

explanation.definitionFit: Carrying on regardless means continuing without pause; literally it is pushing the switch to power up.

clue.text: In a manner of speaking I'd think of it as a misfortune

indicators.note: I'd is placed in the phrase for manner of speaking, so one word goes inside the other

parts.note: an accent is a way of pronouncing words
taken as written, apostrophe dropped

explanation.surface: Someone says that, in their view, it was bad luck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In a manner of speaking' looks like a stock phrase meaning 'so to say', but it gives ACCENT, which takes ID inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A mishap is an unlucky event that happens unexpectedly.

clue.text: Within a month he becomes one of the flock

indicators.note: he sits inside the abbreviated month, one word inside the other

parts.note: SEP is short for September
taken as written

explanation.surface: In the space of a month, a man joins the congregation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one of the flock' suggests a churchgoer, but it is a farm animal.
explanation.definitionFit: A woolly farm animal kept in flocks.

clue.text: Basic reason to cheer on the party emotively

parts.note: to root for a team is to cheer it on
a cause is the side or movement one supports

explanation.surface: A fundamental motive for passionately supporting your party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'emotively' only colours the cheering; ROOT is American slang for cheering a side on.
explanation.definitionFit: The underlying origin of a problem is its fundamental explanation.

clue.text: Old models went by private transport

definitions.meaning: second-hand vehicles sold on
travelled by motor rather than by bus or train, past tense

explanation.definitionFit: Second-hand vehicles are previously owned; travelling in one's own automobiles is taking private transport.

clue.text: Things printed in the newspapers

definitions.meaning: objects or articles
short news pieces or reports

explanation.definitionFit: Articles in a list are individual objects; a press report is a short news piece.

clue.text: Cup result confused 500 done by a chiseller

indicators.note: jumbled up, so the letters of cup and result are mixed with the numeral

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for five hundred

explanation.surface: A cup tie's outcome was muddled, with 500 swindled by a cheat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chiseller' looks like a cheat (British slang), but it is literally one who carves stone with a chisel.
explanation.definitionFit: Carved statues are shaped with a chisel by a stone carver.

clue.text: Knife, fork, spoon set? No you have to fetch your own!

definitions.meaning: a boxed set of cutlery

definitions.text: No you have to fetch your own!
definitions.meaning: a self-service dining hall in a works or school

explanation.definitionFit: A boxed cutlery set has this name, as does a workplace dining room where staff collect their own food.

clue.text: Form coteries may take

indicators.note: to form is to shape or make up, so the letters of coteries are reshaped

explanation.surface: Exclusive cliques may adopt a certain shape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Form' rearranges COTERIES; the whole clue is also the definition, since cliques talk in obscure terms.
explanation.definitionFit: Obscure knowledge understood only by a small inner circle.

clue.text: Is it that family reveals a soft hide?

parts.note: a question opening, as in 'does it rain?'
kin means relatives, family

explanation.surface: A question whether a relative exposes something.
explanation.definitionFit: Supple leather made from deerskin, a smooth soft animal skin.

clue.text: Set broken pieces as pavement edging

indicators.note: in pieces means broken apart, so the letters of set and broken are rearranged

explanation.surface: Set the shattered fragments to make a border for the footpath.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broken' looks like the anagram signal, but it is fodder; 'pieces' does the work.
explanation.definitionFit: The stones lining the edge of a sidewalk next to the road.

clue.text: Become prone not to own up

definitions.meaning: stretch out flat on a bed or the ground
to tell untruths, read with the opposite of up attached

explanation.walkthrough: The second half plays on LIE (deny the truth) plus DOWN, the opposite of up; it is a punning second sense rather than a strict definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Recline flat on the ground; the punning half joins telling an untruth with the reverse of up.

clue.text: Wandering Damon turned up with $0.01

indicators.note: in a down clue, turned up means the name Damon is read from bottom to top

parts.note: one cent: I (Roman one) plus C, the cent abbreviation

explanation.surface: A man called Damon arrived with just a penny.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' reverses DAMON to NOMAD; '$0.01' is one cent, written I C.
explanation.definitionFit: Roving from place to place without a fixed home.

clue.text: Ration distribution appeal in Canada

indicators.note: a distribution spreads things around, so the letters of ration are rearranged

parts.note: O is an exclamation of entreaty, as in 'O, help me'

explanation.surface: A plea for food rationing to be shared out across Canada.
explanation.walkthrough: 'distribution' turns RATION into ONTARI, then the appealing O follows.
explanation.definitionFit: A province of the North American dominion whose capital is Toronto.

clue.text: Old Boy has to wait and take notice

parts.note: OB, abbreviation for a former pupil of a British school
to wait at table is to serve

explanation.surface: A former pupil must hang around and pay attention.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wait' suggests delay but means serving at table.
explanation.definitionFit: To watch attentively, to notice and remark.

clue.text: It is in the church's financial interest

indicators.note: it is placed in the word the, one word inside the other

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Something serves the church's money matters.
explanation.walkthrough: IT goes inside THE. Historically a tenth of produce or income was paid to the parish church.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenth of earnings formerly levied to support the clergy.

clue.text: Multiple occasions

definitions.meaning: multiplied by, as in arithmetic
instances, points at which things happen

explanation.definitionFit: The multiplication sign is read this way; separate occasions are instances in history.

clue.text: Security service has to emphasise she might be a diplomatic risk

definitions.text: she might be a diplomatic risk

parts.note: MI, Military Intelligence, as in MI5 and MI6, the British security services
to stress something is to emphasise it

explanation.surface: Intelligence agents insist that a certain woman could compromise an ambassador.
explanation.walkthrough: A diplomat's secret lover is a blackmail risk, the stuff of spy stories.
explanation.definitionFit: A married man's lover could expose a diplomat to blackmail.

clue.text: Keeping harping on how to mix fat with flour

definitions.meaning: insisting on a point, emphasising it repeatedly

definitions.text: how to mix fat with flour
definitions.meaning: the baking technique of working butter into flour with the fingertips

explanation.definitionFit: Repeating an unwelcome point is laboured insistence; in pastry-making, fingertips work butter into flour.

clue.text: Beat the band

definitions.meaning: to strike hard, to thrash
a strip of leather worn round the waist

explanation.definitionFit: To thrash someone is to hit hard; a strap around the waist is a strip or girdle.

clue.text: Reminder about a book sale bargain

indicators.note: reminder goes round the letter a, about meaning surrounding

explanation.surface: A note concerning a cheap book on sale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks like 'concerning', but it means REMINDER goes around A.
explanation.definitionFit: Unsold copies of a book offered cheaply by the publisher.

clue.text: Why the poor man went all to bits?

definitions.text: Why the poor man went all to bits?

parts.words: Why the poor man went all to bits?
parts.note: a word meaning penniless also means smashed apart

explanation.definitionFit: Penniless people are without money; something smashed went to pieces, the same past-tense word.

clue.text: Run for it as a means of breaking sentence

definitions.meaning: a sprint, a quick ... for safety
a punctuation mark that interrupts a sentence

explanation.definitionFit: A short sprint is a quick race; a horizontal punctuation stroke interrupts written text.

clue.text: Centre-sets arranged for an aspiring film star

indicators.note: something arranged is set in order, so the letters of centre-sets are rearranged

explanation.surface: Central stage sets are laid out for a would-be actress.
explanation.definitionFit: An audition on camera is what a hopeful movie actor must pass.
